metadata.evidence: # Universal Instance Perception as Object Discovery and Retrieval
metadata.reason: Explicitly states the project name in the title and throughout the document.

metadata.value: UNINEXT reformulates diverse instance perception tasks into **a unified object discovery and retrieval paradigm** and can flexibly perceive different types of objects by simply changing the input prompts.
